title: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification on Simplicial Complexes with Conformalized Simplicial Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.41166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simplicial neural networks (SNNs) are powerful tools for prediction tasks on higher-order relational datasets stored on simplicial complexes (SCs), a higher-order generalization of graphs. However, SNNs usually lack rigorous uncertainty quantification (UQ), limiting their usefulness in high-stakes scenarios. We propose conformalized SNN (CF-SNN), a framework that, given a simplicial-complex entity with m prediction targets, generates prediction sets for all m targets simultaneously. Under mild assumptions, CF-SNN guarantees that, for each target, the prediction set contains the true label with a user-specified nominal coverage probability, and the realized miscoverage proportion across all m targets is guaranteed to remain close to the nominal level with high probability. translated_title: 基于保形化单纯神经网络的单纯复形上的自适应不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 单纯神经网络（SNNs）是处理存储在单纯复形（SCs）——一种图的高阶泛化形式——上的高阶关系数据集预测任务的强大工具。然而，SNNs通常缺乏严格的不确定性量化（UQ），这限制了它们在高风险场景中的实用性。我们提出了保形化SNN（CF-SNN），这是一个框架：给定一个具有m个预测目标的单纯复形实体，它能够同时为所有m个目标生成预测集。在温和的假设下，CF-SNN保证对于每个目标，预测集以用户指定的名义覆盖率包含真实标签，并且保证所有m个目标上的实际未覆盖比例以高概率保持在名义水平附近。在广泛的SC预测任务上的大量实验表明，CF-SNN是一个灵活的不确定性量化框架，能够在实现用户指定覆盖率的同时，产生（紧凑的预测集）……
tldr: 提出保形化单纯神经网络（CF-SNN），利用保形预测为单纯复形上的多个预测目标同时生成具有覆盖率保证的预测集，为SNNs提供了严格的不确定性量化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Conformalized Simplicial Neural Networks (CF-SNN), which leverages conformal prediction to simultaneously generate prediction sets with rigorous coverage guarantees for multiple prediction targets on simplicial complexes, enabling principled uncertainty quantification for SNNs.
